name: Football boots
description: Low-cut black sports shoes with a white stripe down each side and a hard sole set with studs for grip on grass.
notes: A standing pair, each shoe 300 mm long and 105 mm wide, toes on +z: black uppers with a white stripe on each side, white laces, a dark lining in the collar and a white moulded sole lifted on nine black studs. The box spans the air between and around the standing pair. Cotton and leather both read as the black leather upper. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wooden clogs
description: A pair of shoes carved whole from blocks of pale wood, closed at the heel, with the toes turned up in a blunt point.
notes: A standing pair, each clog 300 mm long, 110 mm wide and 95 mm tall, toes on +z, all in wood-birch: one solid shoe shape with a dark walnut-toned hollow showing at the opening and a small upturned tip at the toe. The box spans the air between and around the standing pair. The clogs are carved, so the sole and upper share one finish. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Clown shoes
description: Enormous red shoes with a round bulb over the toes, white soles and yellow laces. Walking in them takes care.
notes: A standing pair, each shoe 450 mm long and 150 mm wide, toes on +z: red uppers with a great rounded bulb over the toes, white soles and collars, and yellow laces. The box spans the air between and around the standing pair. Red and yellow follow the usual clown colours. No clumsiness rule is drafted. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Dance shoes
description: Fine black leather dance shoes, laced, on thin suede soles and a tall flared heel.
notes: A standing pair, each shoe 270 mm long and 85 mm wide, toes on +z: black leather uppers on a 50 mm black heel, the thin sole stepping down from the heel to the ball, black laces and a tan lining in the opening. The box spans the air between and around the standing pair. The suede sole uses paperboard-brown, the nearest dull brown. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Dress shoes
description: Polished black leather lace-ups on a leather sole with a low heel. Smart, and poor for running.
notes: A standing pair, each shoe 300 mm long and 100 mm wide, toes on +z: black leather uppers, black laces, a tan lining in the opening, a brown leather sole and a 22 mm black rubber heel. The box spans the air between and around the standing pair. The patent shine has no finish; leather-black stands in. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Espadrilles
description: Light slip-on canvas shoes on soles of coiled rope, made for hot weather.
notes: A standing pair, each shoe 270 mm long and 95 mm wide, toes on +z: navy canvas uppers, a dark opening, and a 20 mm sole of tan rope with three darker rope bands round its edge. The box spans the air between and around the standing pair. Rope has no finish: the sole uses straw-wicker and paperboard-brown. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Flip-flops
description: A pair of cheap foam sandals held on by a single thong between the toes.
notes: A pair of foot-shaped soles 260 mm long and 95 mm wide side by side, toes on +z: a blue foam sole under a grey footbed, and a black thong strap rising from a post near the toes and stepping down to each side. The box spans the air between them and under the straps. Foam and rubber follow the look. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Leather flip-flops
description: Upmarket flip-flops with a thick rubber sole, a leather footbed and wide leather straps. They look good and flap badly.
notes: A pair of foot-shaped soles 270 mm long and 100 mm wide side by side, toes on +z: a thick black rubber sole under a tan leather footbed, with wide brown leather thong straps. The box spans the air between them and under the straps. The tan footbed uses paperboard-tan, the nearest pale leather. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Bomb-disposal overboots
description: Bulky armoured overboots of flame-proof cloth over hard plates, strapped on over ordinary footwear to guard the feet from blasts.
notes: A standing pair, each 340 mm long, 130 mm wide and 165 mm tall, toes on +z: an olive cloth shell on a thick black sole, rigid olive plates over the instep and toes, and two black straps round the ankle. The box spans the air between and around the standing pair. The padding and flame-proof cloth use cloth-olive-drab and polymer-od-green. No damage type for blasts exists, so cut, pierce and blunt stand in for fragments and blast. It takes the feet slot; layering it over shoes waits on a layer rule. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Foot rags
description: Two strips of cotton rag for binding round the feet. Little better than going barefoot, but better.
notes: A flat pair, side by side: each wrap folded to a pad 120 mm by 220 mm in two layers 4 mm thick with one corner turned back, grey cotton rag tied with a darker strip of the same rag round its middle with the loose ends lying on top. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Faux-fur foot wraps
description: Two pads of pale synthetic fur tied round the feet with cord. Warm, if nothing else.
notes: A flat pair, side by side: each wrap folded to a pad 130 mm by 230 mm in two layers 8 mm thick with one corner turned back, pale grey faux fur with staggered tufts of pile, tied with olive cord round its middle with the loose ends lying on top. Faux fur has no finish; cloth-white stands in. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Fur foot wraps
description: Two pads of brown pelt tied round the feet with rawhide. Warm, if nothing else.
notes: A flat pair, side by side: each wrap folded to a pad 130 mm by 230 mm in two layers 8 mm thick with one corner turned back, brown fur with staggered tufts of pile, tied with a rawhide thong round its middle with the loose ends lying on top. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Leather foot wraps
description: Two patches of leather tied round the feet with a thong. Tough, if not much else.
notes: A flat pair, side by side: each wrap folded to a pad 120 mm by 220 mm in two layers 4 mm thick with one corner turned back, brown leather tied with a black leather thong round its middle with the loose ends lying on top. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Felt foot wraps
description: Two patches of grey felt tied round the feet with cord. A little warmth for bare feet.
notes: A flat pair, side by side: each wrap folded to a pad 120 mm by 220 mm in two layers 5 mm thick with one corner turned back, grey felt tied with olive cord round its middle with the loose ends lying on top. Wool felt uses felt-grey. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Geta
description: A pair of flat wooden sandals raised on two crosswise teeth, held on by a padded red cloth thong.
notes: A pair of pale wooden boards 240 mm long and 100 mm wide with clipped corners, side by side, toes on +z, each standing on two crosswise teeth 45 mm tall, with a red cloth thong rising from a post near the toe and stepping down to each side. The box spans the air under the boards and between the teeth. The materials are wood-pine and cloth-red. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
